title: Onye ahụ nke Alaeze kwadoro ihe ịrịba ama ya tupu ya
intro: Njem dị ịrịba ama na-echere ndị nwere obi ike idozi ihe omimi a. N'ime peeji nke Mkpughe, e nwere onye eze nke zutere onye amụma ga-agbanwe obodo dum. Onye a chịrị site n'ocheeze dị anya, nke ọdịnala oge ochie na-eduzi, ruo mgbe oge pụrụ iche nke eziokwu Chineke gbanwere ma onye ọchịchị ma alaeze ruo mgbe ebighị ebi. Ị̀ ga-achọpụta njirimara nke mkpụrụ obi a dị ịrịba ama nke akụkọ ya jikọtara ihe pụrụ iche na ihe omimi?
clues: Achịkwara m mba bara ọgaranya n'ofe mmiri dị anya, nke a maara maka ubi anyị na nnukwu obí eze anyị.
Ike m dị elu karịa, mana alaeze ukwu bịara ịma aka n'ezie ịdị adị na njirimara anyị.
Nnụnụ nta buru ozi pụrụ iche, ihe ijuanya ndị sochiri ya mebikwara echiche m niile gbasara ike.
Mgbe m hụrụ ka ocheeze gbanwere n'ihu m, amaara m na ọ dịghị mmadụ ọ bụla nwere ike inwe ụdị ikike ahụ.
Ekwupụtara m n'ihu ọha na m na-edo onwe m n'okpuru otu Onyenwe eluigwe na ụwa, na-ahapụ ihe niile m ji kpọrọ ihe.
Anyị, dịka mba, hapụrụ ofufe anyanwụ oge ochie wee nabata eziokwu nke gbanwere ihe niile.

arabic: فَقَالَ إِنِّىٓ أَحْبَبْتُ حُبَّ ٱلْخَيْرِ عَن ذِكْرِ رَبِّى حَتَّىٰ تَوَارَتْ بِٱلْحِجَابِ
verse: And he said, "Indeed, I gave preference to the love of good [things] over the remembrance of my Lord until it [i.e., the sun] disappeared into the curtain [of darkness]." (38:32)
